meta.note: Maps major Indian cities to the water board that serves them. hasTariffFile is true only where a real, schema-validated tariff JSON exists in src/data/water-tariffs/ — every other city still uses the honest self-rate-input calculator. Mirrors the discoms.json / gas-cgds.json pattern. IMPORTANT: unlike DISCOMs/CGDs, our /water/[slug] route is STATE-granularity (one page per state/UT), while water boards are CITY-granularity (a state can have multiple boards, e.g. Maharashtra has BMC for Mumbai, PMC for Pune, and PCMC for Pimpri-Chinchwad). Delhi, Chennai, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Hyderabad and Kolkata happen to work cleanly as city routes distinct from their state slugs (see src/app/water/[slug]/page.tsx, which checks board slugs independently of state slugs). BWSSB and BMC were researched but NOT added: their published rates conflict by large margins across every secondary source we could reach, and their official portals were unreachable (cert error / non-machine-readable legacy portal) — publishing either with a confident SOURCED label would risk a wrong number. Revisit if better sources turn up. KMC (Kolkata) is a genuinely different case from every other board here: ordinary single-family Kolkata houses have no separate per-KL/slab water bill at all (likely bundled into property tax) — the only real recurring volumetric rate found in KMC's own official FY2026-27 fee schedule is a flat ₹6/KL BULK rate for housing complexes/gated communities. Modeled with tariff.isBulkOnly=true, which makes WaterBoardPage.tsx render a prominent top-of-page scope notice (housing complexes only, not individual houses) rather than silently presenting bulk figures as a per-house bill. Boards below other than DJB, CMWSSB, PCMC, HMWSSB and KMC are listed for future reference only.
